description: This file defines a class 'VoiceWakeTester' responsible for performing voice recognition testing, including starting/stopping recognition tasks, handling recognition results, and managing related audio sessions for a voice wake word detection feature. It also includes internal state management and debugging support.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTester
classes.description: Main class managing voice recognition testing, including starting/stopping recognition, processing results, and handling audio sessions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts speech recognition with given triggers and locale, setting up audio input and recognition task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing recognition and cleans up resources.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Ends recognition gracefully with a timeout, then stops audio engine.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes recognition result, updates state, and detects wake words trigger.

methods.name: maybeLogDebug
methods.description: Logs transcript debug information if enabled.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures audio session parameters (stub in current code).

methods.name: ensurePermissions
methods.description: Checks and requests microphone and speech recognition permissions asynchronously.
